title: Watts vs watt-hours: power, energy and your daily budget
description: An original animated explainer. Watts are power, a rate; watt-hours are energy, power times time. Why a small stream's 245 W all day (5,880 Wh) beats a 400 W solar panel's three sunny hours (1,200 Wh), how to list your loads in watt-hours a day (a Starlink dish, a laptop, LED lights and phone charging come to about 2,820 Wh), where the spare goes, and the rule that a hydro generator never runs without a load: it needs a dump (diversion) load, or it overspeeds and the voltage spikes.
